heading: How many Thespian points has each student earned?
lead: A student who worked backstage in the fall may be onstage in the spring. Keep their participation together when it’s time to recognize their work.
caption: Sample theatre program showing Thespian points progress.

steps.heading: Record the work
steps.body: After a production closes, record the participation your troupe recognizes, including cast and crew contributions.

steps.heading: Review a student’s history
steps.body: When a student asks where they stand, review the points already recorded across productions before adding a new award.

steps.heading: Keep families in the loop
steps.body: Use program announcements for rehearsal changes and family reminders, and keep point records available for your next recognition meeting.
